decision: D40 (9 Nov 2026, after M6): secondary analysis requested by the user - a detector with more seizures detected than the dataset paper's baselines at slightly fewer false alarms per hour, with post-ictal verification. Settings chosen on the 96 training patients only (out-of-fold, inner CV); committed before the single test evaluation by scripts/paper_points_test.py.
metrics: dataset paper: any-overlap sensitivity (mean over recordings with a seizure), false-alarm events per hour (mean over recordings); time in alarm; SzCORE event metrics

plain.note: best training-fold sensitivity at <= 10 FA/h without verification; the test curve of the same network was already plotted (results/figures/sens_fa_test.png, about 66 % at 8.5 FA/h), so this point is a reference, not a blind test

cascade.selection: stage-1 threshold from {-4, -7, -10} (LightGBM verifier, 96 s); then verifier {lgbm, dwn} x delay {96 s, 48 s} at th1 = -7. Rule fixed before the last configuration finished: highest training-fold sensitivity at <= 10 FA/h; within 1 point prefer the LUT-native verifier, then the shorter delay. Training-fold results at <= 10 FA/h: lgbm/96 s 82.4 % at 9.59; dwn/96 s 81.9 % at 9.62; lgbm/48 s 82.8 % at 9.99; dwn/48 s 81.6 % at 9.68 -> dwn/96 s.
cascade.verifier_training: one DWN (50 LUTs, 8 thresholds, 24 inputs with the highest LightGBM gain) trained with seed 0 on all 118,975 training-fold candidates, then frozen and applied to the stage-1 candidates of each of the 5 final seeds
